purpose: Teach: 茶碗/はさみ/出掛ける/短冊/さくらんぼ/あゆ/前歯/ヤリ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、新しい、絶対、お茶碗、絶対、買ってあげるね
lines.en: Sho, I'm going to buy you a brand new rice bowl. I really mean it.
lines.style: Warm, affectionate opening. Soft emphasis on the promise itself. Unhurried pace. The voice of someone making a small, genuine commitment to a child she loves.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、ぼく、絶対、お工作の、絶対、はさみ、絶対、上手に、絶対、使えるよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I can use scissors really well now. I really can.
lines.style: Small boy's proud certainty. Slight lift on the emphasis — not boasting, but wanting her to know he's getting better. Quick, eager delivery.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、翔くんと、絶対、明日、絶対、お祭りに、絶対、出掛ける、絶対、わね
lines.en: Tomorrow, Sho, let's go to the festival together. I promise.
lines.style: Tender, deliberate. Each phrase lands softly. Slow enough that the child feels the genuine intention behind it. Warm trailing-off at the end.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、ぼくの、絶対、短冊、絶対、お願いを、絶対、書いたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I wrote my wish on the tanzaku. I really did.
lines.style: Eager, almost breathless. Quick tempo. The excitement of having done something he wanted to share. Slight lift at the end, seeking her reaction.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: メイ姉さんから、本気で、絶対、翔くんに、絶対、さくらんぼ、絶対、お送りするわ
lines.en: I'm sending cherries to Sho — special ones, just for you.
lines.style: Animated, bright. Playful emphasis on the gift itself. Quick pace with a small bump of delight. The voice of someone sharing good news she can't quite contain.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、お父さんが、絶対、あゆ、絶対、たくさん、絶対、釣ったって
lines.en: Dad caught so many ayu at the river — did you hear?
lines.style: Animated, engaged. Quick reporting tempo. The energy of a small boy sharing something he finds impressive. Slight rise at the end, inviting her to share his excitement.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、翔くんの、絶対、前歯、絶対、まだ、絶対、抜けてないよね
lines.en: Sho, your front tooth hasn't come out yet, has it?
lines.style: Gentle curiosity. Warm, observant tone — the tone of someone noticing small details about a child. Soft, almost wondering pace. Slight lift at the end, genuine question.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気for、絶対、運動会で、絶対、ヤリ、絶対、投げ、絶対、見たいんだ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I want to see you throw the javelin at sports day. Will you?
lines.style: Eager, earnest request. Slight building intensity on the desire itself. Quick delivery with a soft, hopeful upward turn at the end. The voice of a child asking for something that matters.
